description: National Transportation Atlas Databases — 2005 is a data set deposited in ICPSR by its authors Bureau of Transportation Statistics, United States Department of Transportation. The National Transportation Atlas Databases 2005 (NTAD2005) is a set of nationwide geographic databases of transportation facilities, transportation networks, and associated infrastructure. These datasets include spatial information for transportation modal networks and intermodal terminals, as well as the related attribute information for these features. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 24 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and ICPSR normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-icpsr-repository.
